newsitem.title: USA: Big Dog says registers for 3.5 mln shr IPO.
newsitem.headline: Big Dog says registers for 3.5 mln shr IPO.

text.p: Big Dog Holdings Inc (proposed NASDAQ:BDOG) said Thursday it filed a registration statement for an initial public offering of 3.5 million shares of common stock.
The company said the total size of the offering is expected to range from $42 million to $49 million at the filed price range of $12 to $14 per share of common stock.
Of the 3.5 million shares being offered, 2.8 million are being sold by the company and 700,000 are being sold by the selling stockholders, the company said in a prepared statement.
